purpose: independent-state confirmation of compact target control at the manipulation-validated PaliGemma pathway

site.selection_rule: pre-outcome Action Atlas goal-classification maximum, then retained because full replay redirected target behavior in M0

population.estimand_scope: finite frozen population of 12 scene-prompt contrasts; states are nested replicates and do not expand scene-level scope

observer.target: donor-minus-recipient initial object position in meters
observer.feature: donor-minus-recipient PaliGemma layer-13 per-token residual output
observer.activation_archive_dtype: float16 copied from bfloat16 inference activations; fitting promotes to float64
observer.ridge_scale: fraction of mean diagonal of the training Gram matrix
observer.selection: maximum leave-one-scene-out R-squared on observer-fit states; ties select the larger ridge fraction
observer.final_controller_fit: after the validation gate passes, refit the selected ridge on observer-fit plus observer-validation states; causal-test and reserve states remain untouched
validation_baselines: global mean target displacement from observer-fit states
ordered subject-pair mean from observer-fit states
exact prompt-pair mean from observer-fit states

controller.decoder_inverse_scale: fraction of mean diagonal of beta-transpose-beta

endpoints.primary: donor-object first touch: minimum_norm minus recipient_clean
endpoints.co_primary_selectivity: donor-object first touch: minimum_norm minus matched_random
endpoints.manipulation_check: donor-object first touch: full_replay minus recipient_clean
secondary: patch norm divided by full donor-delta norm

decision_rule.multiplicity: intersection-union: every listed criterion must pass; no favorable endpoint substitution
decision_rule.failed_controller_interpretation: evidence against this linear decoder, norm cap, layer, checkpoint, and frozen LIBERO-CF population only
decision_rule.replication_rule: run the reserve split if and only if every manipulation and compact-control criterion passes on causal_test; never use reserve states to rescue a failed or inconclusive primary test
decision_rule.final_positive_claim: requires the unchanged decision rule to pass again on the reserve split

power_boundary: twelve scene clusters are calibrated for a large target-redirection effect; a null result cannot exclude a 15-percentage-point effect unless its scene-cluster interval does so
claim_boundary: tests oracle-coordinate-assisted compact control of instruction-selected pickup targets, not temporally extended futures, autonomous target inference, planning, task completion, or a general world model
